sql: WITH RemoteListings AS (SELECT family, SUM(CASE WHEN remote_us = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_remote_us_listings FROM mart_daily_market GROUP BY family) SELECT family, open_remote_us_listings, SUM(open_remote_us_listings) OVER (ORDER BY open_remote_us_listings DESC) AS running_total FROM RemoteListings ORDER BY open_remote_us_listings DESC
